scope: TP1 versus TP2 numerical failure diagnosis only; no product repair or threshold change
hardware: 2x gfx1100 W7900, HIP 7.15; canonical exclusive locks held

original_gate.metric: max_abs(logits_ref - logits_tp) / max_abs(logits_ref), worst across positions

experiments.note: 14 rows do not enter the >=64-row IU4 residual branch

localization.admission: exact gfx1100, batch<=16, K divisible by 512, residual LDS-staged enabled; ordinary short prefill also takes this verifier-labelled tier

standalone_residual_oracle.input: deterministic random finite F32 staged to F16, identical nonzero residual
standalone_residual_oracle.gate: PASS original per-operator relative L2 <=5e-5, all finite
standalone_residual_oracle.caveat: Layer-0 weights and this input only; no assertion that every model/layer is bug-free. Reduced warmups/repetitions are diagnostic only, not performance evidence.

quantization_observation.assessment: Observed quantized-code differences and layerwise amplification support small arithmetic perturbations crossing Q8 thresholds and propagating through the network. This is an inference, not proof that Q8 is the sole amplifier.

conclusion.confirmed: Pre-existing clean-beta numerical-gate failure, linked by single-variable intervention to the default small-batch LDS residual tier; not a speed gate and not introduced by the pending TP2 lm_head/scratch optimizations.
conclusion.not_proven: An indexing, tail, synchronization, or memory-safety bug in the LDS kernel; the tested standalone cases pass.
conclusion.next_step: Treat as separate arithmetic-consistency investigation. Do not weaken the gate, silently disable the tier, or claim universal correctness/performance from this fixture. No product fix applied.
